<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_ViennaNightRun" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/viennanightrun">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_ViennaNightRun" name="App For Participating at the Vienna Night Run" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Runner" name="Runner">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_Registration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RunMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Run5km</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_GoalSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GetStartingNumber</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Train</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckWorkday</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TravelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_GoFromHome</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LeaveFromWork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TravelMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RaceParallelSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RunNightRun</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Drink</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RaceParallelJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_App" name="App">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectStartingBlock</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveFinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_FinalTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FitnessGadget" name="Fitness Gadget">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordFiveKmTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRaceTime</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Registration" name="Want to participate">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToSelectBlock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectStartingBlock" name="Select starting block">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToSelectBlock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectBlockToRunMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RunMerge" name="Merge before 5 km run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectBlockToRunMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainToRunMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunMergeToRun5km</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Run5km" name="Run 5 km">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunMergeToRun5km</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Run5kmToRecord</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordFiveKmTime" name="Record 5 km time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Run5kmToRecord</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecordToGoalSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GoalSplit" name="Time under 25 minutes?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecordToGoalSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoalYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoalNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Train" name="Train and check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoalNo</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainToRunMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GetStartingNumber" name="Get starting number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoalYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NumberToCheckWorkday</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWorkday" name="Check time between start and end of workday">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NumberToCheckWorkday</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckWorkdayToTravelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TravelSplit" name="More than one hour left?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckWorkdayToTravelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelFromHome</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelFromWork</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_GoFromHome" name="Go to start from home">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelFromHome</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GoHomeToTravelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveFromWork" name="Leave directly from work">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelFromWork</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LeaveWorkToTravelMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TravelMerge" name="Merge travel options">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GoHomeToTravelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LeaveWorkToTravelMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TravelMergeToParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RaceParallelSplit" name="Run and drink at the same time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TravelMergeToParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToRun</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToDrink</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RunNightRun" name="Run the Night Run">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToRun</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RunToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Drink" name="Drink while running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToDrink</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DrinkToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RaceParallelJoin" name="Race and drinking finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RunToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DrinkToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToCollectTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectRaceTime" name="Collect race time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToCollectTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectToReceiveTime</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" name="Receive final running time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectToReceiveTime</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveTimeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_FinalTime" name="Final running time received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveTimeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToSelectBlock" sourceRef="StartEvent_Registration" targetRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectBlockToRunMerge" sourceRef="Task_SelectStartingBlock" targetRef="Gateway_RunMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunMergeToRun5km" sourceRef="Gateway_RunMerge" targetRef="Task_Run5km"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Run5kmToRecord" sourceRef="Task_Run5km" targetRef="Task_RecordFiveKmTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecordToGoalSplit" sourceRef="Task_RecordFiveKmTime" targetRef="Gateway_GoalSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoalYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_GoalSplit" targetRef="Task_GetStartingNumber">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>time < 25 minutes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoalNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_GoalSplit" targetRef="Task_Train">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>time >= 25 minutes</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainToRunMerge" sourceRef="Task_Train" targetRef="Gateway_RunMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NumberToCheckWorkday" sourceRef="Task_GetStartingNumber" targetRef="Task_CheckWorkday"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckWorkdayToTravelSplit" sourceRef="Task_CheckWorkday" targetRef="Gateway_TravelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelFromHome" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelSplit" targetRef="Task_GoFromHome">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>time left in workday > 1 hour</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelFromWork" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelSplit" targetRef="Task_LeaveFromWork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>time left in workday <= 1 hour</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GoHomeToTravelMerge" sourceRef="Task_GoFromHome" targetRef="Gateway_TravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LeaveWorkToTravelMerge" sourceRef="Task_LeaveFromWork" targetRef="Gateway_TravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TravelMergeToParallelSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_TravelMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RaceParallelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToRun" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_RunNightRun"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDrink" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceParallelSplit" targetRef="Task_Drink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RunToJoin" sourceRef="Task_RunNightRun" targetRef="Gateway_RaceParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DrinkToJoin" sourceRef="Task_Drink" targetRef="Gateway_RaceParallelJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToCollectTime" sourceRef="Gateway_RaceParallelJoin" targetRef="Task_CollectRaceTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToReceiveTime" sourceRef="Task_CollectRaceTime" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveTimeToEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFinalTime" targetRef="EndEvent_FinalTime"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
